description: §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4) — a NON-literal `<page auth=${mode}>` is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID: `auth=` must be one of three quoted literals known at compile time. History: before #1234 it compiled with no diagnostic (the page declared nothing); #1234 made it W-ATTR-002; the ruling makes it an error. No W-ATTR-002 beside it.
rationale: §52.13.2 as amended S449: an `auth=` on a `<page>` or `<program>` that is not exactly `"required"`, `"optional"` or `"none"` — including a `${…}` expression — SHALL be E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
